# Fresh Snow, Default Catalog

Version 1.0.2 keeps a resort working when SnowSure sends no forecast and makes the avalanche link safer, and SnowSure is now in the HACS default catalog.

## Resorts

- **A resort without a forecast stays available.** Off season or for a new resort, SnowSure can send the daily forecast as empty. Before, the integration stopped with an error on that: on first setup the entry kept retrying, later every entity of the resort went unavailable, although snow depth, lifts and avalanche data were there. Now the forecast is simply empty and everything else shows as usual. _[#16]_
- **The avalanche link only opens https addresses.** Every other address from SnowSure was already limited to https, but the link to the avalanche bulletin went straight into the card. Now it is checked the same way: an address that is not https is dropped, and the card shows no link instead. _[#17]_

## Installation

- **SnowSure is in the HACS default catalog.** You no longer need to add it as a custom repository: find it under **Settings** → **Marketplace** from Home Assistant 2026.11, or in HACS on earlier versions. _[#17]_

## Upgrading

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Nothing else to do. If you added SnowSure as a custom repository, it keeps working; you can remove the custom repository entry in HACS, the integration stays installed.
